analysis:
The PIB release of 12 April 2013 set out the National Optical Fibre Network plan to connect all 250,000 gram panchayats. In late August 2013, Sibal was reported in Parliament as saying the project would connect all 2.5 lakh panchayats at up to 100 Mbps over the next two years.

Progress between 2011 and 2014 was limited: reports compiled from government data indicate that only a few hundred kilometres of the roughly 300,000 km of optical fibre required for Phase-I had been laid by 2014, and Phase-I was completed in December 2017.

The two-year connectivity target set in 2013 was not met within that period.
notes: The TOI and ET URLs were seen in search results; the PIB release and the Wikipedia Bharat Broadband Network article were read. The exact sitting date of Sibal's Rajya Sabha reply is reported as Friday 30 August 2013 by the news reports.
